pages.title: Bubble Shooter Vintage
pages.creator: PHATCAT Games Ltd
pages.description: Aim your cannon at clusters of matching bubbles in Bubble Shooter Vintage. Put three or more of a color together to pop them and find new angles as the board opens up.

pages.title: Grand Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Select three identical tiles at a time in Grand Mahjong Connect. Look ahead to the next group before you pick a tile and keep making triples until the board is clear.

pages.title: Slinger Block
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide a red square around sliding blocks in Slinger Block. Pick up every yellow key, work your way to the locked door and open the route to the exit.

pages.title: Obby Yard Sale
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Order mystery boxes and sell what you find in Obby Yard Sale. Set out items for passersby, look out for rare discoveries and use sales to build up the business.

pages.title: Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Help Noob fight through the undead in Noob vs Zombie Apocalypse: shooting pro. Gather coins and switch between weapons such as a shotgun, an Uzi and a grenade launcher as the levels progress.

pages.title: Perfect Job Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Run through workplace-themed courses in Perfect Job Run. Follow the path for your chosen career and make quick choices at the obstacles to see where you end up.

pages.title: Moscow Metro Driver 3D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drive a train along Moscow Metro routes in Moscow Metro Driver 3D. Bring passengers from station to station and explore stops such as Tretyakovskaya and Novokosino on the Kalininskaya line.

pages.title: Mahjong Four Rivers
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Connect matching tiles in Mahjong Four Rivers. Look for a clear route around other pieces and think about which pair to remove first to open up the rest of the layout.

pages.title: Rope Color Sort 3D
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Sort colored ropes into their matching tubes in Rope Color Sort 3D. Use open space to move ropes between tubes until every color is gathered where it belongs.

pages.title: Bobblehead Ball
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Take your big-headed football player into a fast match in Bobblehead Ball. Move into position to meet the ball, then look for the right moment to send it into the opposing goal.

pages.title: Monster Slayer Merge & Survive
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Merge items before heading into the dungeon in Monster Slayer Merge & Survive. Combine your gear to make it more useful and see how far it takes you against the monsters below.

pages.title: Find the Sprunki
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Search each image for twelve hidden figures in Find the Sprunki. Look carefully before clicking, since wrong guesses carry a penalty and the clock is running across all twelve levels.

pages.title: Jigsort Puzzles
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Swap scrambled pieces to restore the artwork in Jigsort Puzzles. Use the colors and edges of each piece to figure out where it goes and try puzzles at different difficulties.

pages.title: Robot Terminator T Rex
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Fight zombies as a mechanical dinosaur in Robot Terminator T Rex. Use the T-Rex's mounted weapons as you move through battles and take on the enemies that approach.

pages.title: Ultimate Sports Car Drift
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Take a sports car through drifting challenges in Ultimate Sports Car Drift. Build enough speed to start a slide and use careful steering to keep it going around each corner.

pages.title: Draw a Weapon - 2D Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Aleksey Kobyakov
pages.description: Sketch objects to defeat the enemies in Draw a Weapon - 2D Puzzle Game. Think about where your drawing will land and how it will interact with the other objects in the scene.

pages.title: Pop It Master
pages.creator: RAD BROTHERS
pages.description: Press every bump on each toy in Pop It Master to unlock the next design. Work through the collection of 140 Pop It and Simple Dimple toys at your own pace.

pages.title: Rings Master
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Rotate rings to solve the puzzles in Rings Master. Pay attention to how changing one ring affects the rest of the arrangement and keep turning them until the pieces line up.

pages.title: Merge Car 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Combine a vehicle and an animal in Merge Car 3D to get a ride with a special ability. Drive it around the circular arena and try to outlast the other vehicles.

pages.title: Craft World - Building Games
pages.creator: Knuckle Games
pages.description: Design houses from more than 300 kinds of blocks in Craft World - Building Games. Choose the materials for each structure and furnish the rooms with the decor you want.

pages.title: Police Bike Stunt Race Game
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Ride a police motorcycle through stunt courses in Police Bike Stunt Race Game. Build speed for jumps and get the bike under control as you make your way through the obstacles.

pages.title: Gum Adventures DX
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Use a sticky character's ability to reach the ceiling in Gum Adventures DX. Switch between surfaces to get around obstacles as you try to reach the other character in each stage.

pages.title: Mini Coins
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Jump over enemies and obstacles to reach the scattered coins in Mini Coins. Try a normal run first, then see how quickly you can gather the coins in speedrun mode.

pages.title: Labo 3D Maze
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Collect keys and unlock doors in Labo 3D Maze. Choose among five characters and find your way through 24 mazes, keeping an eye out for traps along the route.

pages.title: Kitts Kingdom
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Defend Felis as Sergeant Kitt in Kitts Kingdom. Choose weapons for waves of attacking dogs, improve your defenses and prepare for the tougher enemies at the end of the waves.

pages.title: Boat Drift
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Guide a boat around bends in Boat Drift and try to keep each drift going. Collect gold from your runs and put it toward a better boat.

pages.title: Santa On Wheelie Bike
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: Keep Santa's bicycle balanced on its rear wheel in Santa On Wheelie Bike. Adjust as the front end rises or falls and see how far you can go in one wheelie.

pages.title: Halloween Faces Memory
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Study the scary faces while they're visible in Halloween Faces Memory. Remember where the identical ones are hiding and turn them over in pairs as the boards get bigger.

pages.title: Wheel Race 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Choose tires suited to the surface ahead in Wheel Race 3D. Switch when the terrain changes to keep the car from losing speed and get past your opponent.

pages.title: Chaotic Spin
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Send the white ball around its track in Chaotic Spin. Reverse direction to dodge flying objects, and look for openings that let you pick up the white dots safely.

pages.title: Jewels Blitz 4
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Match jewels in Jewels Blitz 4 and help Maya look for treasures in the Central American jungle. Work through the boards as the young princess follows the trail left by her people.

pages.title: Can You Reach 8K
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Combine three or more identical numbers in Can You Reach 8K. Each group doubles in value, so leave room to build bigger matches and see if you can reach 8,000.

pages.title: Brain Wash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Look for unconventional answers to the riddles in Brain Wash. Try interacting with different parts of the scene, and use a hint if a puzzle still has you stuck.

pages.title: Couple in Love Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Put together pictures of couples in Couple in Love Jigsaw. Work through twelve scenes and use matching edges and details to figure out where each piece belongs.

pages.title: Lava And Ninja Skateboard
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Skateboard downhill to escape the lava in Lava And Ninja Skateboard. Collect darts on the way, buy upgrades for the ninja and try to travel far enough to unlock more characters.

pages.title: Merge Ships
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Combine matching boats to develop your fleet in Merge Ships. Make room for more vessels as you build up the business and send larger ships out to sea.

pages.title: Two Wheel Stunts SupeR Car
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Drive along sloped surfaces on two wheels in Two Wheel Stunts SupeR Car. Line up the car for each ramp and try to take every slope for a higher score.

pages.title: Motorcycle and Girls Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures of motorcycles and girls in Motorcycle and Girls Puzzle. Start with a 16-piece image or choose a larger puzzle with up to 100 pieces.

pages.title: Right Shot
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Pull back the elastic and release a ball in Right Shot. Work out the angle and force that can knock the targets down with as few shots as possible.

pages.title: Scatty Maps Mexico
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Place Mexican states where they belong in Scatty Maps Mexico. Try to complete the map quickly and use the state details to learn their flags, capitals and populations.

pages.title: Water Surfing Car Stunts Car Racing Game
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Drive a car across water in Water Surfing Car Stunts Car Racing Game. Steer through the course and keep control of the vehicle as you take on the aquatic stunt sections.

pages.title: Colored Circle
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Rotate the four-color ring in Colored Circle so the ball meets a segment of its own color. Watch the bounce and line up the next matching segment before it arrives.

pages.title: Birds Board Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare two boards of birds in Birds Board Puzzles. Select the single difference to get a new pair of boards, and see how many you can spot before time is up.

pages.title: Swans Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of swans in Swans Slide by shifting the tiles around the grid. Choose one of three images and try the different modes for more ways to solve it.

pages.title: Puzzle Kostenlos
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Choose a picture to reconstruct in Puzzle Kostenlos. Play any of the six images with 16, 36, 64 or 100 jigsaw pieces and move them into place at your own pace.

pages.title: Find Cat 2
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Look for a cat that keeps slipping away in Find Cat 2. Search places such as the park and shops, and collect objects that help you uncover its hiding spot.

pages.title: Cake Pops Maker
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Make bite-sized desserts in Cake Pops Maker. Follow the preparation steps for your cake pops and decide how you want to decorate the finished treats.

pages.title: Super Goin Up
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Climb by jumping in Super Goin Up and stomp enemies you encounter on the way. Use your progress to improve your stats and see how much higher you can get.

pages.title: Knife Climb
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Throw the knife from one target to the next in Knife Climb. Aim your throws carefully to stay above the lava and keep climbing for a better score.

pages.title: Christmas Vehicles Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Compare pictures of festive vehicles in Christmas Vehicles Differences. Check the small details in both scenes and click the spots where decorations or other parts of the pictures change.

pages.title: 2048 Balls
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Drop balls into the pile in 2048 Balls and bring matching numbers together. Each merge creates a higher value, so keep some space open while you work toward bigger balls.

pages.title: Hit Ball 3D
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Hold to fire a stream of balls at the towers in Hit Ball 3D. Release when an obstacle swings into the line of fire and resume when the target is clear.

pages.title: Christmas Illustration Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together six holiday illustrations in Christmas Illustration Puzzle. Select a picture and choose a smaller board or one with up to 100 pieces to fit into place.

pages.title: Ultimate Car Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Take a car out into a large open world in Ultimate Car Simulator. Try out the driving areas and customize your vehicle before taking it back on the road.

pages.title: Colorful Skull Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Reassemble bright skull illustrations in Colorful Skull Jigsaw. Choose one of twelve pictures, then pick a 25-, 49- or 100-piece layout to suit the challenge you want.

pages.title: Christmas adventure
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Guide a character through 2D stages in Christmas adventure. Move along the platforms and shoot enemies with the A key or the touch controls as you work through the route.

pages.title: Haunted House Hidden Ghost
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Spot the ten hidden stars in each picture in Haunted House Hidden Ghost. Scan the haunted scenes carefully and find all the stars before time runs out in each of six levels.

pages.title: Offroad Hill Climb Jeep Driving Simulator 2019
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Take a Jeep up steep roads in Offroad Hill Climb Jeep Driving Simulator 2019. Slow down around sharp twists and keep the vehicle steady on rough uphill stretches.

pages.title: Ragdoll.io
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Fight other floppy characters in Ragdoll.io. Use the physics to swing your fighter into opponents and try to land the stronger blows in battles on the space island.

pages.title: Idle Gold Mine
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Upgrade your gold operation in Idle Gold Mine. Improve how often miners work and how much they can handle to build up production as the mine brings in more gold.

pages.title: Basketball.io
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Move the ball past defenders in Basketball.io and look for chances to score. Compete in tournaments and try to get the timing right as the action shifts around the court.

pages.title: White Archer
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Line up your bow with the target in White Archer. Aim for the center on each shot and adjust when the next target calls for a different angle.

pages.title: Red Hands Slap
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take turns slapping and dodging in Red Hands Slap. Watch the other hand and time your move, with separate controls for two players and two modes to try.

pages.title: Xtreme Demolition Arena Derby
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Smash rival vehicles to earn points in Xtreme Demolition Arena Derby. Take control of a derby car and use the arena to line up another hit as opponents move around you.

pages.title: Dinosaur Digging
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dig up dinosaur bones in Dinosaur Digging and clean away the dirt. Put the bones together in puzzle stages to see how the pieces fit into a skeleton.

pages.title: Jump In The Wall
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Keep jumping between walls in Jump In The Wall. Time your moves to stay in play and gather gems to unlock new skins for later runs.

pages.title: Tactical Weapon Pack
pages.creator: Wilkin Games
pages.description: Try out firearms and attachments in Tactical Weapon Pack. Take on the four ranked challenges and see how your shooting compares with other players on the scoreboards.

pages.title: Car Toys Japan Season 2
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Work through physics puzzles with toy cars in Car Toys Japan Season 2. Find a way around the obstacles and earn three stars to open bonus levels.

pages.title: Backgammon
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Roll dice and move your pieces toward your home board in Backgammon. Plan around the moves available each turn and take your checkers off before the opponent does.

pages.title: Pumpkin Find Odd One Out
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Find the Halloween symbol that doesn't match its neighbors in Pumpkin Find Odd One Out. Compare the icons closely and pick out the one detail that breaks the pattern.

pages.title: Brick Out
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Bounce a ball from the paddle into the wall of bricks in Brick Out. Stay under the ball as it comes back down and aim your returns at the remaining gaps.

pages.title: Dragon Fire and Fury
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Defend the dragon's hoard in Dragon Fire and Fury. Make matches on the puzzle board to use your defenses against the enemies trying to reach the treasure.

pages.title: Blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Place block shapes in a grid in Blocks Puzzle. Clear complete rows or columns and leave openings you can use for the next pieces to keep the board playable.

pages.title: Sumo Party
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Try to shove the other wrestlers out of the ring in Sumo Party. Play with a friend and watch where you move as the fighters close in for a push.

pages.title: Kizi Kart
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Choose a character and race in Kizi Kart. Dodge hazards and overtake rivals in the Star Course, Rocket Race or Kizi Cup as you try for first place.

pages.title: Aim Clash 2
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Line up attacks against your opponents in Aim Clash 2. Read the terrain before you shoot and use each new level to work on hitting targets from different positions.

pages.title: Dr. Acorn 2
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Help Doctor Acorn find his missing light disc in Dr. Acorn 2. Work out how the objects in each scene can get him past the obstacles along his route.

pages.title: Pregnant Moms Fashion Looks
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style the expecting princesses for a party at Rachel's house in Pregnant Moms Fashion Looks. Browse the dresses and pick something for each guest to wear that evening.

pages.title: Football Flap Flap
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Keep a football in the air in Football Flap Flap. Tap to adjust its height, thread the gaps between pipes and watch for flying spikes as you cover more distance.

pages.title: Archery War
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Take aim at rival archers in Archery War. Judge the distance between fighters in the sky and change the angle of each shot until you can hit the other side.

pages.title: Tea Time
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help a teddy bear host her friends in Tea Time. Get things ready for the gathering and finish the preparations before the guests arrive for tea.

pages.title: Grindcraft
pages.creator: Playsaurus Inc.
pages.description: Gather raw materials and turn them into equipment in Grindcraft. Work through the crafting combinations to make tools and unlock more things to build as you move into new areas.

pages.title: Tiles
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear connected groups of the same color in Tiles. Look for clusters that open up another move after they disappear and see how many boards you can work through.

pages.title: Princess Total Makeover
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give the princess a makeover in Princess Total Makeover. Try different makeup styles and choose a favorite before putting together the clothes and accessories to go with it.

pages.title: Risky Mission
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Line up shots against enemy targets in Risky Mission. Watch the blocks around each target and aim the gun so your shot gets through to the enemy behind them.
